classification: Analytical plotting-position verification and serialization regression

baseline.behavior: Replacing ExactSeries incremented the plotting-position version but left every new observation at its default plotting position of zero.
baseline.effect: FittingAnalysis consumed probability one after complementing each zero, producing infinite quantiles and RMSE for otherwise successful MLE candidates.

implementation.programmatic_replacement: A valid whole-series replacement performs one derived-state refresh after event handlers are attached.
implementation.invalid_transient_replacement: The replacement remains accepted without throwing and derived-state refresh is deferred until the frame is valid.
implementation.xml_deserialization: All four series replacements suppress derived-state refresh, preserve persisted plotting positions, and rebuild effective threshold counts once after loading.

analytical_verification.formula: Nonexceedance probability for ascending order statistic i is i/(n+1).
